blocks.x: Which one is that, Danny? A (?) bowl?
No, that's for "Don't You Feel My Leg."
That's the title, "Don't You Feel My Leg"?
She done this record, and she came here. She's coming here. She'll be here tomorrow night.
That's right. Tomorrow night is her evening.
